description: Every row of Table A (industry categories) and Table B (asset categories) in Schedule 2 of the Commissioner of Taxation's effective life determination named in source, in the instrument's order. Each row is an array in the order columns gives. depth is the row's nesting under the rows above it: a row with no life is a heading for the deeper rows that follow it, or a cross-reference. life_years is the life as the instrument prints it and life_months is the same life in months. flags holds the instrument's third column: * means the life has been reviewed in the Commissioner's ongoing review and # means a capped life is available under section 40-102 of the Income Tax Assessment Act 1997. last_updated is the date the instrument gives for when the life was last reviewed and determined. White space and no-break hyphens in the instrument's text are written as ordinary spaces and hyphens.
